title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 44 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and maritime & undersea autonomy.

stories.h: Shield AI cofounder teases ‘snowball’ of X-BAT fighter drone announcements in Europe
stories.what: Ryan Tseng told Breaking Defense that the prospective deals and new industry pacts will be publicized when “we’re ready to announce them.”
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: Israel Weapons Industry expands into Southeast Asia with Thailand’s deployment of counter-drone system
stories.what: “We are seeing strong demand for our platforms and systems across the region,” the company said in response to questions about its growth strategy for southern Asia.”
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: Saildrone expands its European market reach with manufacturing partner in Norway
stories.what: CEO Tom Fidjeland told reporters at the Euronaval trade show here that taking on the work of churning out Surveyors was “technically not difficult,” with a first mold already being readied.
stories.you: Being able to produce at scale has become a competitive edge in its own right; factories are now a venture category.

stories.h: India taps two domestic shipbuilders for $5.7B corvette program
stories.what: India awarded Garden Reach Shipbuilders Engineers and Goa Shipyard Limited contracts to build five and three corvettes, respectively, for the country’s navy.
stories.you: Allies' wars and budgets are the testing ground and a big second market for new defense tech.

stories.h: Chinese satellites track U.S. carrier group crossing South China Sea
stories.what: Satellite imagery released by the Chinese commercial company MizarVision appears to show the USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71) carrier strike group in the South China Sea on Nov. 4, as the carrier heads toward the Middle East.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

watch.why: November 10. Could squeeze drone, motor and munitions supply weeks before the DoD ban.

idea.h: GPS-denied navigation module ('Intel Inside' for drones)
idea.why: A small vision, inertial and terminal-guidance board any airframe maker can integrate; later, quantum-ready. Jamming is everywhere; most vendors can't build autonomy in-house. As airframes become commodities, the margin sits in components like this.
